additionalProperties.title: credential provider command
additionalProperties.description:
Credential provider command for this alias: an executable path with optional arguments. Reference the alias name from `registry.global-credential-providers` or `registries.<NAME>.credential-provider`.

[Cargo documentation](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#credential-alias)

oneOf.title: command string
oneOf.description: Path and arguments, split on spaces.

oneOf.title: path and arguments
oneOf.description: Executable path followed by arguments, passed through verbatim. Use this form for a path or argument containing spaces.

prefixItems.description: Path to the credential provider executable, or the name of a built-in `cargo:` provider.

propertyNames.description: Alias name, as referenced from `registry.global-credential-providers` or `registries.<NAME>.credential-provider`. A non-empty token with no whitespace: those references are split on spaces, so a name containing whitespace can never be resolved. Names of built-in providers are rejected because Cargo ignores aliases that shadow them.
